sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Strength is a Physical skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Increasing strength allows you to jump higher, sprint faster, hit harder, throw farther, and carry more weight.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Level 15 of this skill is needed for the story chapter Batya

sections.heading: Hideout
sections.text: - Level 2 of this skill is needed for the Vents level 3

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases jump height (0.4% per level → +20% at Elite Level)
- Increases carrying weight (0.6% per level → +30% at Elite Level: 100 kg)
- Increases melee strike power (0.6% per level → +30% at Elite Level)
- Increases movement and sprint speed (0.4% per level → +20% at Elite Level)
- Increases throw distance (0.4% per level → +20% at Elite Level)
- Reduces stamina drain while aiming (0.4% per level → +20% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Weapons equipped on sling and on back don't count towards total character weight
- Elite level: Chance to deal critical melee damage (+50%)

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Walk or sprint while being overweight (>33.77% of current total weight)
- Using throwable weapons
- Using melee weapons
- Using the Gym
- Completing the quest A Life Lesson
- Completing the quest Never Too Late To Learn
